$why: Moved out of spec-mode-runner.js deriveGuardVocabulary on 2026-08-15 (4 of 20).
The terms this returns feed a BM25/IDF ranker, so the prompt decides what the search
amplifies and what it demotes. It carries FOUR conditional sections — persona,
documentation, evidence and the CodeGraph verify block — each assembled by the caller and
arriving whole or empty. A template that branches is a program.
body:
__PERSONA_PREFIX__GUARD SEAM: __SEAM__

THE RULE THIS GUARD ENFORCES:
__RULE__

THE STATEMENTS THE GUARD WILL CHECK:
__STATEMENT_LIST__

DECLARED MANIFEST (the files this story says it will touch):
__MANIFEST__

__DOC_SECTION__CODE EVIDENCE (real findings from this repository — ground truth; derive from these, not from your own knowledge of any library):
__EVIDENCE__

STORY CONTEXT:
Title: __STORY_TITLE__
Description: __STORY_DESCRIPTION__
__CODEGRAPH_SECTION__
description: Derive the vocabulary a guard uses, verified against the repository index.
$mayBeEmptyWhy: Both are REAL absent states, and production passes '' for them: spec-mode-runner supplies __CODEGRAPH_SECTION__ only when a codegraph tool AND a repo path are present, and __DOC_SECTION__ only when the story references documents. Without this declaration the prompt layer refuses to render for any project that has not provisioned the codegraph plugin — deriveGuardVocabulary then returns null, which its own callers must read as 'the guard could not be armed'. So the guard silently disarmed itself on exactly the projects least likely to notice. Unlike a brief or a tool grant, an absent section here reads correctly as absent.
$whyMayBeEmpty: Declared 2026-08-27 by sweeping the CLASS rather than the instance, after three runs died on it one placeholder at a time. Every call site for these writes an explicit empty branch — the story is not being split, attempt one carries no forced-retry note, no documentation was fetched, the persona prefix is optional — so absence is a real state, which is the renderer's own test. Placeholders supplied by a lookup that may FAIL (`x || ''`) are deliberately NOT here: for those, empty means broken, and declaring them would hide the blank-brief defect the renderer exists to surface. Unanimity is required — one deliberate branch among several defensive lookups is not a licence.
